Two actions. Think ahead.

Use arrows/WASD, the direction buttons, or tap an adjacent tile. Moving costs 1 action. Bumping a foe strikes for 1 damage.

Orange tiles show exactly where foes will strike at the end of your turn. Blue dots show their planned movement. Dodge, then retaliate.

Pulse costs 1 action and deals 2 damage to every adjacent foe. Use it once per encounter. Clear all three encounters; recover 1 heart between them.
